name: egress-approver
changelog:
v3: a native view for the xbin app (native.js): the approval queue with swipe actions and whois as a pushed screen; the formatters moved into fmt.js, shared with the page
v2: response helpers come from the SDK (xbin.WriteJSON)
v1: default-deny net provider with human-in-the-loop per-IP approval
title: Egress Approver
description: A default-deny firewall tile with a human in the loop. Bind other components' network to it and every new outbound destination IP is held for you to approve or deny — with reverse DNS and RDAP/whois detail. Approved destinations show live bytes in/out. A worked example of a programmable net provider.
